info.description: Browser-based server access through auto-provisioned encrypted mesh tunnels. No SSH keys, no VPN, no bastion hosts.
info.title: hopssh API

post.description: Authenticate with email and password. Returns session token and sets cookie.
Destroy the current session and clear the session cookie.
Create a user account with email and password. Returns session token.

get.description: Returns whether any users are registered. Used by frontend to show register or login form.
Downloads a pre-generated tarball containing agent certs and config. Single-use, expires after 15 minutes.

post.description: User enters the code shown on the server terminal. Selects a network and authorizes the device.
Initiates the device authorization flow. Returns a device code for polling and a user code for the human to enter at /device.
Agent polls this endpoint to check if the user has authorized the device code. Returns enrollment data when authorized.

get.description: Check if a user code is valid and pending authorization.

post.description: Called by the install script. Validates the one-time enrollment token, issues a Nebula certificate, and returns connection details. The enrollment token is consumed and cannot be reused.

parameters.description: Version the change is made against
parameters.name: If-Match

409.description: a rule set with that name exists

get.description: Returns all mesh networks owned by the authenticated user with node counts.

post.description: Creates a new isolated mesh network. Auto-generates Nebula CA (Curve25519), allocates /24 subnet, and issues server certificate.

get.description: Returns network details, subnet info, and all nodes.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a network, all its nodes, and associated PKI material.

post.description: Creates a pre-enrolled node and generates a single-use download URL for a tarball containing all certs and config.

parameters.description: Version the change is made against
parameters.name: If-Match

post.description: Issues a "user" cert for a client device to join the mesh. Returns certs and lighthouse info.

get.description: Returns all nodes in a network with their status, hostname, OS, and last-seen time.

post.description: Generates a one-time enrollment token for a new node. Returns the curl install command to run on the server.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a node from the network, closes its mesh tunnel and any active port forwards.

post.description: Executes a command on the node via the agent. Output is streamed as text/plain. The response ends with a ---EXIT:N--- marker containing the exit code.

get.description: Proxies a health check to the agent on the node via Nebula mesh. Returns hostname, OS, architecture, and uptime. Updates the node's last-seen timestamp.

post.description: Creates a local TCP listener that proxies connections through the Nebula mesh to a remote port on the node. Similar to kubectl port-forward.

get.description: Upgrades to WebSocket and relays a PTY shell session to the agent. Supports terminal resize via binary control frames. Uses xterm-256color.
Returns all active TCP port forwards for a network.

delete.description: Closes an active port forward. Active connections are given 3 seconds to drain before force-close.

post.description: Agent calls this to get a fresh short-lived Nebula certificate. Authenticated via the per-node bearer token.

401.description: Invalid token or node not found

clientType.description:
ClientType is "desktop" (bundled in or installed by the macOS
.app) or "cli" (standalone hop-agent binary). Build-baked at
the agent — not affected by runtime mode (a "desktop" build
running as the system LaunchDaemon still reports "desktop").
Empty string for legacy / pre-v0.10.52 agents that don't report.

connectivity.description:
Connectivity is derived from PeersDirect / PeersRelayed at serialize time.
Values: "" (unknown — agent hasn't reported), "idle" (no peers),
"direct" (all peers direct), "relayed" (all peers relayed),
"mixed" (some direct, some relayed). Skipped entirely for lighthouse nodes.

peers.description: parsed from peer_state JSON; nil if never reported

rttMs.description:
RTTms is the agent-measured EWMA-smoothed TCP-connect round-trip
to the peer's mesh API listener (port 41820). Populated only
when Direct=true; relayed peers report 0. 0 means "no sample
yet" (brand-new peer, or relayed). See cmd/agent/peerstate.go.
